changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetResult') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetResult] ( Uid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, EffectiveDate datetime NOT NULL, RunDate datetime NOT NULL, PassCount bigint NOT NULL, FailCount bigint NOT NULL, TotalCount as (PassCount+FailCount) persisted, PassFraction as (PassCount / (PassCount+FailCount)) persisted, CreatedOn datetime NOT NULL, CreatedBy int NOT NULL, UpdatedOn datetime NOT NULL, UpdatedBy int NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_AssetResult PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( Uid ASC ) ) AS NODE END
